title: Lest It Happen: Negative Purpose with nehogy
grammar: Negative purpose clauses with nehogy + subjunctive
goal: I can construct negative purpose clauses using nehogy + subjunctive ('lest / so that ... not')
I can distinguish neutral negative purpose (azért, hogy ... ne) from precautionary/apprehensive nehogy
I can use standalone nehogy! in urgent spoken warnings
